description:
## [1.2.0](https://github.com/josselinonduty/morphe-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-11-23)

### ✨ New Features

* **snapchat:** add one-time modified-app disclaimer ([4d64827](https://github.com/josselinonduty/morphe-patches/commit/4d64827ec58e8238ad51331ffbfbb73be93be597))

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Blocks ad insertion (incl. chat feed sponsored rows), Blizzard analytics uploads and removes the advertising ID permissions.

patches.name: Disable location
patches.description: Removes location permissions and reports no usable location provider.

patches.name: Hide My AI
patches.description: Hides the My AI row from the Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Team Snapchat
patches.description: Hides the Team Snapchat row from the Chat list.

patches.name: Remove Games tab
patches.description: Shows the plain Camera icon and label in the center tab instead of Games.

patches.name: Remove Map tab
patches.description: Removes the Map tab from the tab bar.

patches.name: Remove Spotlight tab
patches.description: Removes the Spotlight tab from the tab bar.

patches.name: Remove Stories tab
patches.description: Removes the Stories tab from the tab bar.

patches.name: Show disclaimer
patches.description: Shows a one-time warning before the login screen: Snapchat has historically been unfriendly to modified apps, so only use accounts you do not care about.

patches.name: Spoof Snapchat signature
patches.description: Required for login: reports Snapchat's original public certificate to in-process readers.
